pairs: And you who have no money:
emite absque argento et absque ulla commutatione vinum et lac.
Quare appenditis argentum non in panibus,
Why do you spend money for what is not bread,
et laborem vestrum non in saturitate?
and expend your labor for what does not satisfy?
et delectabitur in crassitudine anima vestra.
and then your soul will be delighted by a full measure.
And I will make an everlasting covenant with you,
by the faithful mercies of David.
I have presented him as a witness to the people,
as a commander and instructor to the nations.
Behold, you will call to a nation that you did not know.
et gentes quæ te non cognoverunt ad te current,
And nations that did not know you will rush to you,
because of the Lord your God,
Seek the Lord, while he is able to be found.
Call upon him, while he is near.
Let the impious one abandon his way,
and the iniquitous man his thoughts,
and let him return to the Lord,
and he will take pity on him,
for he is great in forgiveness.
Non enim cogitationes meæ cogitationes vestræ,
For my thoughts are not your thoughts,
and your ways are not my ways,
Quia sicut exaltantur cæli a terra,
For just as the heavens are exalted above the earth,
sic exaltatæ sunt viæ meæ a viis vestris,
so also are my ways exalted above your ways,
et cogitationes meæ a cogitationibus vestris.
and my thoughts above your thoughts.
Et quomodo descendit imber et nix de cælo, et illuc ultra non revertitur,
And in the same manner as rain and snow descend from heaven, and no longer return there,
et germinare eam facit, et dat semen serenti, et panem comedenti:
and cause it to bloom and to provide seed to the sower and bread to the hungry,
sic erit verbum meum quod egredietur de ore meo;
so also will my word be, which will go forth from my mouth.
It will not return to me empty,
but it will accomplish whatever I will,
et prosperabitur in his ad quæ misi illud.
and it will prosper in the tasks for which I sent it.
For you will go forth rejoicing,
and you will be led forward in peace.
montes et colles cantabunt coram vobis laudem,
The mountains and the hills will sing praise before you,
et omnia ligna regionis plaudent manu.
and all the trees of the countryside will clap their hands.
In place of the shrub, the pine tree will arise,
and in place of the nettle, the myrtle tree will grow.
et erit Dominus nominatus in signum æternum quod non auferetur.
And the Lord will be named with an eternal sign, which will not be taken away.
